ev.mng_j_stallion.title: A breeding stallion
ev.mng_j_stallion.text: A neighbour is selling a stallion of a rare colour - black, long-necked, with a fierce eye. From a horse like that, they say, come foals that run forty versts without breaking a sweat. But he asks a fortune.
ev.mng_j_stallion.buy.ok: The stallion leads your band of mares and bites everyone but you.
ev.mng_j_stallion.own.ok: Your horses are plainer, but well fed and calm.
ev.mng_j_stallion_later.title: The foals
ev.mng_j_stallion_later.text: The black stallion has sired foals each finer than the last. A buyer for the khan's herds offers the price of ten mares for a three-year-old.
ev.mng_j_stallion_later.sell.ok: The silver is counted, and now your name is known among the khan's herds.
ev.mng_j_stallion_later.keep.ok: At the festival your three-year-old comes in first. They rub his head with kumis and sing his praises.
ev.mng_j_shearing.title: Shearing
ev.mng_j_shearing.text: Spring shearing: the sheep are thrown on their sides, their legs tied, and they are clipped with shears. There is a lot of wool. A buyer offers a good price - but by autumn it will be needed for felt for a new yurt.
ev.mng_j_shearing.sell.ok: You sell the wool. Felt can always be bartered for.
ev.mng_j_shearing.felt.ok: In autumn the whole family helps roll your felt. The new yurt is whiter than snow.
ev.mng_j_wolves.title: Wolves at the flock
ev.mng_j_wolves.text: In the night wolves have come to the flock - three of them, maybe five. The bankhar dogs are straining at their chains, and the sheep have huddled together, bleating.
ev.mng_j_wolves.fight: With a club and the dogs
ev.mng_j_wolves.fight.success: You kill a grown wolf. Its pelt hangs by the door - the neighbours are envious.
ev.mng_j_wolves.fight.failure: A wolf sinks its teeth into your arm. Two lambs are carried off.
ev.mng_j_wolves.fire.ok: The wolves fall back, taking one sheep. The rest are safe.
ev.mng_j_blizzard_ride.title: A letter in the blizzard
ev.mng_j_blizzard_ride.text: A courier white with frost gallops into the yam: "A letter for the khan, urgent!" The fresh horse is yours, and the next station is forty versts on. But outside the blizzard is so thick you cannot see your outstretched hand.
ev.mng_j_blizzard_ride.ride.success: You make it, tied to your saddle. The letter goes on without delay.
ev.mng_j_blizzard_ride.ride.failure: The horse loses the road. You are found in the morning half frozen.
ev.mng_j_blizzard_ride.wait.ok: The letter is half a day late. The station master enters a reprimand against you.
ev.mng_j_yam_horses.title: Horses lost at the station
ev.mng_j_yam_horses.text: Couriers have ridden three station horses to death. By the regulations a yam must keep twenty-five head at all times, or the station master gets the rod. The inspector arrives in a week.
ev.mng_j_yam_horses.own.ok: You bring your own horses. The inspector is pleased and writes you down as diligent.
ev.mng_j_yam_horses.bribe: Come to terms with the inspector
ev.mng_j_yam_horses.bribe.success: The inspector counts the horses on his fingers and comes up three short only in his head.
ev.mng_j_yam_horses.bribe.failure: The inspector turns out to be honest. A fine and the rod.
ev.mng_j_keshig_night.title: The night watch
ev.mng_j_keshig_night.text: You are on the night watch at the khan's yurt. By the yasa no one may approach the khan at night without being summoned - not even his brother. And a great noyan, a little drunk, comes up to you saying he has "important business".
ev.mng_j_keshig_night.stop.ok: You cross the spears. In the morning the khan praises you - and the noyan remembers you.
ev.mng_j_keshig_night.let.ok: The noyan goes through. How it ended you will find out later.
ev.mng_j_soldier_arban.title: Inspection of the ten
ev.mng_j_soldier_arban.text: Before the campaign the commander of the hundred inspects every man: three horses, a bow and two quivers, a sabre, a lasso, needle and thread, a cooking pot, a bag of dried meat. For anything missing, the whole ten gets the rod.
ev.mng_j_soldier_arban.drill.ok: You have everything, down to spare bowstrings. The commander holds you up as an example.
ev.mng_j_soldier_arban.ease.ok: The commander glances at your second quiver but says nothing.
ev.mng_j_promote_officer.title: A hundred
ev.mng_j_promote_officer.text: Your commander has fallen in battle, and the commander of the thousand names you in his place. Now you answer for a hundred men - their horses, their arrows and their lives.
ev.mng_j_promote_officer.accept.ok: You are handed a centurion's paiza. The leaders of ten bow, and the old soldiers size you up.
ev.mng_j_promote_officer.decline.ok: You ask to be left in your ten. The commander of the thousand shrugs.
ev.mng_j_officer_spoils.title: Dividing the spoils
ev.mng_j_officer_spoils.text: The city has fallen. By the yasa the spoils are divided strictly: the khan's share, the commander's share, each ten's share. No one is stopping your men from keeping something back - but if it comes out, you will answer for it.
ev.mng_j_officer_spoils.fair.ok: Everything by tally, to the last earring. The commander of the thousand grunts his approval.
ev.mng_j_officer_spoils.more.ok: The hundred are content, and your saddlebag is heavier. Now you can only hope no one informs.
ev.mng_j_promote_mingghan.title: A thousand
ev.mng_j_promote_mingghan.text: The kurultai has confirmed you as commander of a thousand. From now on a thousand families and their pastures are under you - and above you only the commander of the tümen and the khan.
ev.mng_j_promote_mingghan.accept.ok: You receive the golden paiza of a commander of a thousand. Your yurt is now a headquarters.
ev.mng_j_promote_mingghan.decline.ok: You ask to keep your hundred.
ev.mng_j_falcon.title: The white gyrfalcon
ev.mng_j_falcon.text: A white gyrfalcon has been caught in your snares - a bird fit to be given only to khans. For six weeks you go without sleep, "manning" it on your fist until it begins to take meat from your fingers.
ev.mng_j_falcon.khan.ok: The khan accepts the falcon and rewards you with silver and a place in his hunts.
ev.mng_j_falcon.keep.ok: With the white gyrfalcon on your fist you take cranes. The district has never seen such hunting.
ev.mng_j_bow_commission.title: A bow for the noyan
ev.mng_j_bow_commission.text: A noyan has ordered a score of bows for the spring campaign. A true bow takes a year to cure, but the noyan needs them in three months - and he pays double if you make it.
ev.mng_j_bow_commission.slow.ok: You deliver half on time and half by autumn. The noyan grumbles, but the bows never miss.
ev.mng_j_bow_commission.fast.ok: The bows are ready on time. How they behave in the frost will be learned on campaign.
ev.mng_j_rain_rite.title: Drought
ev.mng_j_rain_rite.text: A summer without rain: the grass is scorching and the mares are losing their milk. The elders bring you nine white sheep: let the shaman call down rain with the jada stone, as the Turks did of old.
ev.mng_j_rain_rite.rite: Perform the rite for three days
ev.mng_j_rain_rite.rite.success: On the third day a cloud comes in from the west. Now they call you "master of the rain".
ev.mng_j_rain_rite.rite.failure: The Sky stays silent. People turn away from your yurt.
ev.mng_j_rain_rite.honest: Say the Sky does not bargain
ev.mng_j_rain_rite.honest.ok: The elders leave disappointed. But you did not lie.
ev.mng_j_shaman_vs_lama.title: A contest with a lama
ev.mng_j_shaman_vs_lama.text: A Tibetan lama has challenged you before the noyan: let the shaman's spirits show their power against the power of the Buddha. The lamas go from camp to camp burning ongons, and people are watching to see who will win.
ev.mng_j_shaman_vs_lama.contest.success: Your drum thunders till nightfall, and the lama gives way. But there are many such lamas.
ev.mng_j_shaman_vs_lama.contest.failure: The noyan declares the lama the winner. Your drum is burned, and you are made to take vows.
ev.mng_j_shaman_vs_lama.yield.ok: You give your drum to the monastery. Your heart feels strangely light.
ev.mng_j_caravan_robbed.title: Bandits at the Dzungarian Gate
ev.mng_j_caravan_robbed.text: The caravan has been stopped in the mountains. The bandit chief demands a third of the goods. You carry the khan's paiza: by the yasa anyone who touches a merchant under the khan's protection will be executed together with his kin.
ev.mng_j_caravan_robbed.yasa.success: The bandit turns pale and escorts the caravan to the pass himself.
ev.mng_j_caravan_robbed.yasa.failure: "The khan is far away," grins the bandit, and takes half.
ev.mng_j_caravan_robbed.ransom.ok: You give up a bale of silk. The rest will get through.
ev.mng_j_darkhan_forge.title: A cauldron for a thousand
ev.mng_j_darkhan_forge.text: For the kurultai a copper cauldron is needed big enough to boil forty sheep at once. No smith in the district has ever cast such a thing. The noyan is looking at you.
ev.mng_j_darkhan_forge.accept.ok: For three days you pour the cauldron without leaving the furnace. It rings like a bell when struck.
ev.mng_j_darkhan_forge.decline.ok: The order goes to a Uyghur master. You feel easier.
ev.mng_j_census_scribe.title: The census
ev.mng_j_census_scribe.text: The khan's census: every person, horse and sheep goes into the book, so that taxes and soldiers can be counted. A rich merchant whispers to you: "Write me down for fewer camels - I won't forget you."
ev.mng_j_census_scribe.honest.ok: The book tallies to the last lamb. The head of the chancery takes notice of you.
ev.mng_j_census_scribe.bribe.ok: There are ten fewer camels in the book - and more silver in your purse.
ev.mng_j_scribe_promote.title: Into the chancery
ev.mng_j_scribe_promote.text: You are summoned to the khan's chancery - to write patents and keep the registers of the relay stations. The work is important but dangerous: a mistake in a patent can cost your head.
ev.mng_j_scribe_promote.go.ok: You sit down at a low desk among Uyghur and Persian scribes. It smells of ink and felt.
ev.mng_j_baskak_rise.title: A baskak's post
ev.mng_j_baskak_rise.text: The khan offers you a post as baskak in the Russian lands: to watch the princes, keep the census and collect the tribute. The princes will bow to you - and hate you. In Tver, they say, the baskak Chol Khan was burned alive with his men.
ev.mng_j_baskak_rise.accept.ok: You receive the patent and a troop. Ahead lie forests and foreign towns.
ev.mng_j_baskak_rise.refuse.ok: You plead illness. The post goes to another.
ev.mng_j_baskak_tver.title: Murmurs in the town
ev.mng_j_baskak_tver.text: There has been a bad harvest in the Russian town, and the tribute has not been gathered. In the market people are muttering, and someone is ringing the assembly bell. Your men await your orders.
ev.mng_j_baskak_tver.force.success: The tribute is gathered. The town is silent, but glares at you.
ev.mng_j_baskak_tver.force.failure: A mob storms your compound. You barely escape the burning house.
ev.mng_j_baskak_tver.soft.ok: You put off the collection until autumn. The prince sends thanks and sables.
ev.mng_j_felt_order.title: Felt for the court
ev.mng_j_felt_order.text: For the khatun's great yurt snow-white felts are needed with the red "ox horn" pattern. It is work for the whole winter - but they pay in silver.
ev.mng_j_felt_order.accept.ok: The khatun runs a finger along the pattern and nods. Now your name is known at court.
ev.mng_j_felt_order.kin: Make felt for your own people
ev.mng_j_felt_order.kin.ok: You make felt for the neighbours to songs and laughter. Less money, but more fun.
ev.mng_j_matron_camp.title: The khatun while her husband is away
ev.mng_j_matron_camp.text: The men have been on campaign for two years now. It is for you to decide when to move to the summer pasture, which widows to give livestock to, and how to punish the herdsman who lost a herd. The old noyan-adviser suggests waiting for news.
ev.mng_j_matron_camp.decide.success: You move the camp to the summer pasture earlier than usual - and win the best grazing.
ev.mng_j_matron_camp.decide.failure: A late frost strikes the early move. But people respect you for your resolve.
ev.mng_j_matron_camp.wait: Wait for word from your husband
ev.mng_j_matron_camp.wait.ok: The messenger arrives two months later. The neighbours have taken the best meadows.
